references.text: Describes Israel's conquest of the Amorite territory, the same region mentioned in Judges 11:22
Mentions the Arnon as a boundary, the same geographical reference found in Judges 11:22
Moses describes the conquest of the land from Aroer by the Arnon valley, paralleling the boundary description in Judges 11:22
Describes the same territory from the Arnon to the Jabbok that was given to Reuben and Gad
The entire passage concerning Israel's victory over Sihon and the conquest of the Amorite land that Jephthah refers to
Mentions Sihon, king of the Amorites, and his territory from the Arnon to the Jabbok
Describes how Moses gave the land of the Amorite kings to the tribes of Gad and Reuben
